ARIF HABIB DOLMEN 
REIT 
MANAGEMENT 
LIMITED 
10th July 2019 
The General Manager 
Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited 
Stock Exchange Building 
Stock Exchange Road 
Karachi. 
Subject: 
DECLARATION OF FINAL DIVIDEND OF DOLMEN CITY REIT FOR THE YEAR ENDED 
30th JUNE 2019 
Dear Sir, 
We have to inform you that Board of Directors of Arif Habib Dolmen REIT Management Limited, the 
Management Company of Dolmen City REIT (the Scheme), in their meeting held on Wednesday, iov 
July 2019 at 11:00 am at Arif Habib Centre, 23 M.T. Khan Road, Karachi, have recommended the 
following: 
(i) 
CASH DIVIDEND 
The Board of Directors have declared and approved a final cash dividend of Re. 0.33 per unit 
i.e. 3.3%}. This is in addition to interim dividends already paid of Re. 0.99 per unit i.e. 9.9%. 
On cumulative basis the Scheme has approved dividend of Rs. 1.32 per unit i.e. 13.2% for the 
Year ended 30th June 2019. 
The above entitlement will be paid to the unit holders' whose names will appear in the register of 
Unit Holders' on Friday, 16th August 2019. 
The Share Transfer Books of the Scheme will be closed from 19th August 2019 to 25th August 2019 
(both days inclusive). Transfers received in order to at the office of our share registrar Mis. Central 
Depository Company of Pakistan Limited, CDC House, 99-B, Block-B. S.M.C.H.S, Main Shahrah-e- 
Faisal, Karachi at the close of the business on Friday, 16th August 2019 will be treated on time for the 
purpose of above entitlement to the transferees. 
This is for the information and notice of all Unit Holders of the Scheme. You may please also inform 
the TRE Certificate Holders of the Exchange accordingly. 
Q Ari] Habib Centre, 
23, M.T. Khan Road, Karachi.
